experiment: P5p checkpointed protocol-generic verified-idle shared frozen-forward and dense bounded-head execution
research_question: With the P5e five-model bounded-JNR candidate unchanged, does one shared frozen base forward preserve complete full-pool outputs exactly and reduce guarded per-inference-batch latency relative to two frozen base forwards?
single_changed_axis: P5p changes no scientific mechanism, candidate, data role, batch, output check or timing rule from P5o. It adds immutable crash-audit receipts and explicitly prohibits resume after an interrupted identity pool.

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: Proceed only under the unchanged P5h no-external-Python-CUDA guard before launch, after analytic collection, before/after every timing call, and after execution. Record the failed mode-switch command and every guard receipt.
authorized_environment.launch_precondition: No external Python CUDA process may exist. P5p must pass protocol validation and receipt self-test before any P5p data generation.

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: all five power views remain together; every new pool must have zero overlap with all locally retained historical train identities

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125, no data-dependent sampling
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment
execution.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after every call. Guard before/after full-pool equivalence and every warmup/repeat; reject any external Python PID whose nvidia-smi pmon type contains C.

checkpoint_contract.self_test: A no-data/no-CUDA receipt self-test must leave a launch and started receipt but no completed receipt and classify it as interrupted_before_pool_completion_no_resume.

stop_rule: Any failed protocol or receipt self-test, external CUDA Python PID, exception, missing required receipt, output non-equivalence or latency-gate failure freezes all P5p identities with no result claim. No implementation, model, feature, batch, scheduling, compiler or quantization change is allowed after P5p data generation.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a confirmation pass supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution per-batch cost claim. It never establishes a new architecture or classification claim.
